column3: Close to the Hebrew; “fatherless ones, and there is no father” is rendered “orphans and waifs.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at our neck we are pursued” is rendered “They pursue at our heels.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with our life” is rendered “at the risk of our lives.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the burning heat of hunger” is rendered “the fever of famine.”
Close to the Hebrew; “young men lifted a mill” is rendered “Young men ground at the millstones,” and the second “young men” “Boys.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “gathering” (“have ceased gathering at the gate”).
